notes.title: Fighting Club and Roid Rage Update
notes.notes:
The latest update to Gym Empire bring in some huge functionality that add a whole new dynamic to the game!

To celebrate there will be a week long 20% Discount from 9th October!

[h2]Fighting Club[/h2]
Fighting Club is the first wave of Sports additions to Gym Empire. Bringing in the ability to add Boxing, Wrestling and MMA Equipment to your Gym. The update also includes a new Sports Need for Clients, which indicates what Sports the Client is interested in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/6c059099fcc276d40b3efb17e1e66c52bd5c8c94.png[/img]

Future Sports additions will include Football, Basketball, Swimming, Running and more. The Sports functionality also acts as the foundation for Celebrities, where Clients go on to become superstars in their chosen profession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/440eadb7f9df0b9b9ae7eebd30f1e58cc9a43887.png[/img]

[h2]Roid Rage[/h2]
Roid Rage brings in Roiders to Gym Empire. Oversized, loud and annoying Clients who bring down the mood of the Gym and cause damage to Equipment. Roiders will be attracted to Gyms that cater to their bulking needs so beware! You'll need to get rid of them quickly so they don't wreck your Gym and don't try to return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652500/f4aef2e161f6ff9e0ff51fb47748946bbcc686fd.png[/img]

Alongside the Roid Rage update, different Client types are now attracted to different Gym types based on the Gym Equipment available.

Image by vectorpouch on Freepik

notes.title: Fight Club Update
notes.notes:
The latest build now comes with the first big updates to Gym Empire. The Fight Club Update. Bringing with it Boxing, Wrestling and MMA Rings! 

Along with the Rings come new animations and behaviours for the Clients, as well as new stats that relate to the sport they are interested in (Boxing, Wrestling or MMA). The underlying Client stats will be evolved with more detail over future releases where they will play a part in the journey of dedicated Clients from regular gym goers to Sports Stars!

Turn your Gym into a specialised combat gym of your choice.

notes.title: Gym Empire 30% Early Access Release Week Sale!

The culmination of 5 years of blood, sweat and passion is finally here! 

What better way to celebrate than with 30% off!

[h2]Gym Empire Release[/h2]
Gym Empire releases tomorrow (21st July 2023) with a 30% release week discount. Now if that seems like a pretty steep discount, then it's because it is. But there is a verry good reason why we decided to go with 30% off.

I couldn't have gotten to this point without you and your support. To reward that support for everyone who believes in Gym Empire and for those that want to join us during the Early Access release week I want to reward you all with a huge 30% off. Because joining an Early Access game takes trust and belief in the game itself and the developers ability to deliver on their promise of a fantastic game experience. So I want to show my trust to and give you all a one off 30% discount to say thank you.

[h2]Gym Empire Early Access[/h2]

If there's one thing I could ask, as difficult as it is for me to do... Would be if you could leave an honest review on release day or the days shortly after. Not only will this help me develop Gym Empire but it will do absolute wonders for the visibility of Gym Empire on the Steam Store during release week. An impact that will make a HUGE difference to the success of our Gym Empire.

Thank you and I can't wait to see your amazing gyms come to life!

notes.title: Gym Empire - Gym Tycoon Release Date Update
notes.notes:
After a lot of though and consideration the Gym Empire Early Access release date has been updated to 12th July 2023.

Over the next four months, Gym Empire is going to evolve into an even greater and feature packed game. Giving you even more than was initially planned for Early Access. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OWsbPsm.gif[/img]

The main reasons to move the Gym Empire release date into Summer 2023 are as follows:

[list]
[*] Add more features to ensure Gym Empire is a feature rich experience
[*] Allow more time for YouTube coverage in the build up to release
[*] Enable Gym Empire to appear in the Summer Next Fest
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmu6lxc.gif[/img]

Although it was a tough choice to make, as we want to get Gym Empire available to you as soon as possible. We genuinely believe that it is the right decision for the success of Gym Empire and the will give you the best experience from it.

Bring on Summer 2023!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZbqMLA.gif[/img]

notes.title: Gym Empire - Gym Tycoon Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
A few years ago this moment felt like a long distant dream. A light at the end tunnel that I couldn't yet see...

[h2]Five Years Later[/h2]
After five years of hard work, commitment and passion, with a huge amount of support from the community, the Gym Empire Early Access release date is finally coming. On 12th July 2023 Gym Empire will be available on Steam at a reduced price (about 70% the cost at Full Release) for Early Access adopters and a way to say thank you to all the great support so far.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OWsbPsm.gif[/img]

The road up until this point has taken many turns. With many changes going into the design and look of Gym Empire, most of which have come from great ideas in the community. One thing, however, has always remained clear in the road map for Gym Empire. Early Access will be a complete gameplay experience, providing a full slice of all the gameplay mechanics in the game. From this foundation, the next 6 months to a year of development will focus on fleshing out the existing mechanics by providing extra content and features.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmu6lxc.gif[/img]

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Gym Empire already focuses on a strong comedy element. With Clients suffering ridiculous accidents and radio DJ's Tom & Tom, AKA Biscuits and Gravy, providing a humorous background to the hard work and iron pumping of the Clients. Early Access development will plan to continue growing on the humour with Rival Gym, Celebrities and Monthly Awards. As well as expanding the variety and options for Gym development e.g. boxing rings, swimming pools and basketball courts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZbqMLA.gif[/img]

I'm so excited for you to all start your Gym Empire and I hope you are too!

Add Gym Empire to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/756300/Gym_Empire/]Steam Wishlist now[/url].
